soalan: Read the caption: 'BREAKING: Heavy floods hit the east coast; thousands evacuated overnight.' What is the main event reported?
pilihan: A festival began on the coast
maklum_balas: The caption states floods hit the east coast and thousands were evacuated, so B is the reported event.

soalan: In a news report, the word 'headline' most nearly means:
pilihan: the title printed in large type at the top of a story
the final paragraph of an article
maklum_balas: A headline is the large-type title at the top of a news story.

soalan: A presenter says: 'Tune in at nine for tonight's main bulletin.' What time should viewers watch?
maklum_balas: The presenter clearly says nine, so C is correct.

soalan: Which text type is designed mainly to persuade readers to buy a product?
maklum_balas: An advertisement is written to persuade readers to buy, so A is correct.

soalan: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence for a news report.
pilihan: The minister said, "We will act quickly."
The minister said we will act quickly
The minister said; "We will act quickly"
the minister said "We will act quickly."
maklum_balas: Direct speech needs a comma before the quotation and correct capitalisation and end punctuation inside the quotation marks.

soalan: Complete this reporting sentence using the passive: 'The scandal ___ by an online newspaper last week.'
maklum_balas: Reporting a past action done to the subject needs the past passive 'was reported'.

soalan: 'Social media allows news to spread within minutes, yet not every viral post is accurate.' What does the writer point out?
pilihan: Fast spread does not guarantee accuracy
maklum_balas: The linker 'yet' signals a contrast: speed does not ensure accuracy.

soalan: 'Sadly, many young readers accept sensational headlines without checking the facts.' What is the writer's attitude?
maklum_balas: The word 'Sadly' and the criticism show the writer is concerned.

soalan: During a class presentation on fake news, which sentence best signals your main point?
pilihan: Anyway, that is all I think
The key message today is: always verify before you share
I am not really sure about this topic
maklum_balas: Stating 'The key message today is...' clearly signals the main point to the group.

soalan: In 'The report was biased, favouring one side unfairly,' the word 'biased' means:
maklum_balas: 'Favouring one side unfairly' explains that 'biased' means one-sided.

soalan: A columnist writes: 'We drown in information but starve for understanding.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: People lack access to any information
Having lots of information does not mean we truly understand it
maklum_balas: The contrast between 'drown in information' and 'starve for understanding' shows that abundant information does not equal understanding.

soalan: You must argue against believing every trending story. Which point is strongest?
pilihan: Trending stories are fun to read
Popularity is decided by clicks, not by accuracy, so trends can mislead
maklum_balas: Linking popularity to clicks rather than accuracy gives a reasoned argument against trusting trends.

soalan: 'If broadcasters chase ratings above truth, the public pays the price.' What can be inferred about the writer's stance?
pilihan: The writer warns that prioritising ratings harms the public
The writer thinks truth is unimportant
maklum_balas: 'The public pays the price' implies the writer warns against putting ratings before truth.

soalan: Which response best expresses a reasoned opinion for a media-literacy blog?
pilihan: I believe schools should teach media literacy because it helps students judge sources critically
maklum_balas: It states an opinion and justifies it with a reason, as required for an opinion response.

soalan: Read the notice: 'Vacancy: Part-time cashier, weekends only, apply by 30 June.' What is being advertised?
maklum_balas: The notice advertises a part-time cashier vacancy for weekends.

soalan: In a job advert, 'applicant' means:
pilihan: a person who applies for a job
maklum_balas: An applicant is someone who applies for a position.

soalan: Which document lists a person's education and work experience for a job application?
maklum_balas: A CV (curriculum vitae) lists education and work experience.

soalan: An interviewer says: 'The shift starts at eight in the morning.' When does the shift begin?
maklum_balas: 'Eight in the morning' means 8 a.m.

soalan: Choose the correct present perfect sentence for a CV statement.
pilihan: I have worked as a waiter for two years.
I working as a waiter for two years.
I am work as a waiter for two years.
I has worked as a waiter for two years.
maklum_balas: 'Have worked' is the correct present perfect for an action continuing up to now.

soalan: Complete correctly: 'She is good at ___ customers politely.'
maklum_balas: After the preposition 'at' we use the gerund 'serving'.

soalan: 'Although the salary was modest, the trainee valued the experience she gained.' What did the trainee value most?
maklum_balas: Despite the modest salary, she valued the experience, shown by the contrast with 'Although'.

soalan: In an interview, which reply best explains and justifies a career ambition?
pilihan: I want any job, I don't mind
I hope to become an engineer because I enjoy solving practical problems
maklum_balas: It states the ambition and justifies it with a reason, as the standard requires.

soalan: 'Frankly, overworking staff for low pay is neither fair nor sustainable.' What is the writer's opinion?
maklum_balas: 'Neither fair nor sustainable' shows the writer disapproves of overworking underpaid staff.

soalan: Which greeting is appropriate for a formal application letter?
maklum_balas: 'Dear Sir or Madam,' is the correct formal register for an application letter.

soalan: Which sentence best explains an advantage of part-time work for a student?
pilihan: It provides income while allowing time to study, balancing money and grades
maklum_balas: It clearly explains a benefit by weighing income against study time.

soalan: A writer states: 'A job is not merely a paycheck; it shapes who we become.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Work influences our identity, not just our income
maklum_balas: The contrast with 'not merely a paycheck' stresses that work shapes identity.

soalan: You argue that soft skills matter as much as qualifications. Which point supports this best?
pilihan: Employers value teamwork and communication because tasks are rarely done alone
maklum_balas: Linking teamwork and communication to real workplace needs gives a strong supporting reason.

soalan: Which statement best weighs a disadvantage of taking the first job offered?
pilihan: Accepting too quickly may trap you in a role that does not match your goals
maklum_balas: It explains a genuine drawback by linking a hasty choice to poor fit with goals.

soalan: Read: 'Flight MH07 to Langkawi departs at 10:15 from Gate 4.' Which gate should passengers use?
maklum_balas: The notice states Gate 4, so B is correct.

soalan: In travel writing, 'itinerary' means:
pilihan: a planned schedule of a journey
maklum_balas: An itinerary is a planned schedule or route of a trip.

soalan: An announcement says: 'Check-in closes thirty minutes before departure.' When does check-in close?
maklum_balas: The announcement clearly says thirty minutes before departure.

soalan: Which text type gives a personal account of places visited on a holiday?
maklum_balas: A travel blog gives a personal account of places visited.

soalan: Complete with the correct future form: 'The tour ___ at dawn tomorrow, according to the fixed timetable.'
maklum_balas: A fixed timetable uses the present simple 'leaves' for future scheduled events.

soalan: Choose the correct first conditional: 'If it ___ tomorrow, we will visit the museum instead.'
maklum_balas: The first conditional uses present simple 'rains' in the if-clause.

soalan: 'Because the coastal road was flooded, the driver took a longer mountain route.' Why did the driver change route?
maklum_balas: The reason marked by 'Because' is that the coastal road was flooded.

soalan: When planning a trip with friends, which reply best explains an advantage of travelling by train?
pilihan: Taking the train lets us enjoy the scenery without the stress of driving
maklum_balas: It explains a clear advantage of train travel, meeting the standard.

soalan: 'What a breathtaking valley, unlike anything the tourists had ever seen!' What is the writer's tone?
maklum_balas: 'Breathtaking' and the exclamation convey amazement.

soalan: In 'The resort was secluded, far from the crowds and noise,' 'secluded' means:
maklum_balas: 'Far from the crowds and noise' explains that 'secluded' means private and quiet.

soalan: Choose the correct second conditional to express an imaginary holiday: 'If I ___ more time, I would explore the whole island.'
maklum_balas: The second conditional uses the past simple 'had' for an unreal present situation.

soalan: In a travel story, the setting shifts from a busy airport to a silent desert. What effect does this contrast create?
pilihan: It shows the price of tickets
It heightens the traveller's sense of escape and calm
maklum_balas: Contrasting the busy airport with the silent desert emphasises the feeling of escape and calm in the setting.

soalan: Which sentence best expresses a personal response for a travel journal?
pilihan: Standing on the summit, I felt a deep sense of freedom I had never known before
maklum_balas: It expresses genuine feelings and reflection, suiting a personal travel journal.

soalan: A writer notes: 'The best souvenirs are not bought but remembered.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Memories matter more than objects when we travel
Travel is a waste of money
maklum_balas: Contrasting 'bought' with 'remembered' stresses that memories outlast objects.

soalan: Read: 'Mount Kinabalu, in Sabah, is the highest peak in Malaysia.' Where is Mount Kinabalu?
maklum_balas: The text states Mount Kinabalu is in Sabah.

soalan: In a geography text, 'coastline' means:
maklum_balas: A coastline is the land along the edge of the sea.

soalan: Which text would you read to learn the location, climate and population of a country?
maklum_balas: A factual description gives facts about location, climate and population.

soalan: A guide says: 'The village lies to the north of the lake.' Where is the village?
maklum_balas: The guide clearly says the village lies to the north of the lake.

soalan: Choose the correct non-defining relative clause: 'Kuala Lumpur, ___ is the capital, attracts many tourists.'
maklum_balas: 'Which' introduces a non-defining clause referring to a place or thing.

soalan: Complete with the correct quantifier: 'There isn't ___ rainfall in the desert region.'
maklum_balas: 'Rainfall' is uncountable, so we use 'much' in a negative sentence.

soalan: 'While the lowlands are humid and hot, the highlands remain cool all year.' How are the highlands described?
maklum_balas: The contrast with the lowlands shows the highlands stay cool all year.

soalan: Explaining a map to classmates, which sentence describes a location most clearly?
pilihan: The river flows from the mountains in the east to the coast in the west
I don't know where it is
maklum_balas: It gives clear directional detail, explaining the location precisely.

soalan: In 'The terrain was rugged, full of steep rocks and sudden cliffs,' 'rugged' means:
maklum_balas: 'Steep rocks and sudden cliffs' explain that 'rugged' means rough and uneven.

soalan: 'Regrettably, unchecked development is scarring these once-pristine landscapes.' What is the writer's attitude?
maklum_balas: 'Regrettably' and 'scarring' show the writer is critical of the development.

soalan: A writer states: 'Borders are drawn on maps, but rivers and mountains ignore them.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Nature does not follow the political boundaries humans create
maklum_balas: The contrast shows nature ignores the human-made borders on maps.

soalan: After reading about disappearing islands, which is the best personal response to a global issue?
pilihan: Rising seas threaten island communities, so we must cut emissions urgently
Maps should be redrawn for fun
maklum_balas: It analyses the global issue and gives a reasoned personal response, as the standard requires.

soalan: You must evaluate a claim that a place is 'the most beautiful on Earth.' Which evaluation is most balanced?
pilihan: It is definitely the best, no question
Beauty is subjective, so such a claim depends on personal taste and cannot be proven
maklum_balas: Recognising subjectivity makes for a balanced evaluation of the claim.

soalan: Choose the sentence with correct non-defining punctuation.
pilihan: The Amazon which is the largest rainforest is shrinking.
The Amazon, which is the largest rainforest, is shrinking.
The Amazon which is the largest rainforest, is shrinking.
The Amazon, which is the largest rainforest is shrinking.
maklum_balas: A non-defining clause must be enclosed by a pair of commas.

soalan: Read: 'The new app lets users pay bills using their fingerprint.' What can users do with the app?
maklum_balas: The text states users can pay bills using their fingerprint.

soalan: In a technology article, 'gadget' most nearly means:
maklum_balas: A gadget is a small, clever electronic device.

soalan: Which text explains, step by step, how to set up a new smartphone?
maklum_balas: A user manual gives step-by-step instructions for using a device.

soalan: A presenter says: 'The robot can work for twelve hours without recharging.' How long can the robot work?
maklum_balas: The presenter states twelve hours without recharging.

soalan: Choose the correct third conditional: 'If the engineers ___ the flaw, the launch would not have failed.'
maklum_balas: The third conditional uses past perfect 'had noticed' for an unreal past.

soalan: Complete with the correct modal perfect: 'She left her phone at home; she ___ forgotten it.'
maklum_balas: 'Must have forgotten' expresses a logical deduction about the past.

soalan: 'Although smartphones connect us globally, they can isolate us from those beside us.' What point is made?
pilihan: Smartphones can both connect and isolate people
maklum_balas: The contrast with 'Although' shows the double effect of connecting yet isolating.

soalan: In a discussion, which reply best explains a disadvantage of online learning?
pilihan: Without face-to-face contact, some students feel less motivated and connected
maklum_balas: It clearly explains a genuine drawback of online learning.

soalan: 'It is worrying how easily personal data is harvested by these apps.' What is the writer's attitude to data collection?
maklum_balas: 'It is worrying' shows the writer is concerned about data collection.

soalan: In 'The software update was obsolete within months,' 'obsolete' means:
maklum_balas: 'Within months' and the context show 'obsolete' means out of date.

soalan: A writer argues: 'Technology is a tool, not a master; how we use it defines its worth.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: The value of technology depends on how humans use it
maklum_balas: 'Not a master' and 'how we use it defines its worth' show human use determines value.

soalan: You argue for limiting children's screen time. Which point is strongest?
pilihan: Excessive screen time can harm sleep and concentration, affecting learning
maklum_balas: Linking screen time to sleep, concentration and learning gives a reasoned argument.

soalan: 'If we hand every decision to algorithms, we risk forgetting how to think.' What can be inferred about the writer's stance?
pilihan: The writer cautions against over-relying on technology for thinking
maklum_balas: 'We risk forgetting how to think' implies a caution against over-reliance on algorithms.

soalan: Which sentence best weighs both sides of automation in factories?
pilihan: Automation raises output and safety but may cut jobs, so retraining workers is vital
maklum_balas: It balances a benefit against a drawback and offers a solution, meeting the standard.

soalan: Read: 'Volunteers are needed this Saturday to clean the riverbank. Gloves provided.' What will volunteers do?
maklum_balas: The notice states volunteers will clean the riverbank.

soalan: The word 'charity' most nearly means:
pilihan: an organisation that helps people in need
maklum_balas: A charity is an organisation that helps people in need.

soalan: An organiser says: 'We meet at the community hall at eight sharp.' Where is the meeting point?
maklum_balas: The organiser states the meeting point is the community hall.

soalan: Which text type asks people to support a cause and take action?
maklum_balas: An appeal poster asks people to support a cause and act.

soalan: Choose the correct sentence offering help.
pilihan: Shall I carry those boxes for you?
Shall I carrying those boxes for you?
Shall I carried those boxes for you?
Shall I to carry those boxes for you?
maklum_balas: 'Shall I carry...?' is the correct base-form offer of help.

soalan: Complete: 'The students enjoy ___ meals to the elderly every weekend.'
maklum_balas: After 'enjoy' we use the gerund 'delivering'.

soalan: 'Even though she was tired, Aina stayed to comfort the frightened child.' Why did Aina stay?
maklum_balas: Despite being tired, she stayed to comfort the child, shown by 'Even though'.

soalan: Which reply best explains and justifies your feelings about volunteering?
pilihan: I feel proud when I volunteer because I can see the direct impact on families
maklum_balas: It expresses a feeling and justifies it with a reason, as the standard requires.

soalan: 'How heart-warming it is to see teenagers giving up weekends for others!' What is the writer's tone?
maklum_balas: 'Heart-warming' and the exclamation show an admiring tone.

soalan: In 'The donors were generous, giving far more than expected,' 'generous' means:
maklum_balas: 'Giving far more than expected' shows 'generous' means giving freely.

soalan: A writer says: 'The smallest act of kindness outweighs the grandest intention.' What is the main idea?
pilihan: Actually doing a small kind act matters more than merely intending great things
maklum_balas: The contrast shows that small real actions beat grand unfulfilled intentions.

soalan: You argue that community service should be part of school. Which point is strongest?
pilihan: It builds empathy and responsibility while helping people who genuinely need support
maklum_balas: Linking service to empathy, responsibility and real need gives a reasoned argument.

soalan: Which sentence best expresses an imagined opinion for a campaign speech?
pilihan: Imagine a town where no one is left behind; together, we can build that today
maklum_balas: It expresses an inspiring, imagined opinion suited to a campaign speech.

soalan: After reading about food waste beside hunger, which is the best personal response to this global issue?
pilihan: It is unjust that food is wasted while others starve, so we should support food banks
I only care about my meals
maklum_balas: It analyses the issue and gives a reasoned, responsible personal response.
